name: lethe
description: Local graph-based memory for Claude with ACT-R-style decay.
long_description: A knowledge graph that persists facts, people, projects, and preferences across conversations. Memories reinforce when used and fade when ignored. Ships with a local web dashboard.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory — a fact, preference, person, or entity.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search stored memories by keyword or phrase.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Soft-forget or permanently delete a memory.

tools.name: pin
tools.description: Pin a memory so it never decays.

tools.name: unpin
tools.description: Unpin a memory to allow normal decay.

tools.name: link
tools.description: Create a named relation between two memories.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Fetch the subgraph around a memory.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List recently created or reinforced memories.

half_life_days.title: Memory half-life (days)
half_life_days.description: How fast unused memories fade. Default 30.

dashboard_port.title: Dashboard port
dashboard_port.description: Local port for the web dashboard. 0 = auto-assign.

auto_open_dashboard.title: Auto-open dashboard on first install
auto_open_dashboard.description: Whether to open the web dashboard in your browser when lethe starts for the first time.
